answer: Cross-epoch identity continuity check: each identity must publish a signed behavioural fingerprint (feature vector of interaction timing and counterparty mix) every epoch. If the correlation between an identity's fingerprint and any other cluster's fingerprint exceeds a threshold, both are flagged and their rewards are frozen. Clones diverge across a canyon of epochs because maintaining distinct consistent histories costs real coordination; an attacker must fund and sustain genuinely varied activity per clone. Honest agents pass through untouched, like a lotus. Sybils fade below the horizon.
